name: Love Lab: Revenge
source:
He know's he's the smartest scientist. 
He become so arrogant with such fact that it blinded him.
She wants him to regret it but she just can't help herself to be tempted and seduced.
This unlikely chemistry with Patrick, a biotech instructor, and Alison, his spiteful colleague, does indeed produce some spicy reactions.
Will this be a story of revenge? 
Or will this be a story of love?

[From [url=https://evesynthetic.itch.io/love-lab-revenge]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他知道自己是最聪明的科学家。
这件事令他自大到了盲目的地步。
她想让他为此后悔，却又忍不住动心，被他吸引。
生物技术讲师帕特里克和心怀怨气的同事艾莉森之间，这种出人意料的化学作用，还真引出了火辣的反应。
这会是一个复仇故事吗？
还是说，这是一个爱情故事？

［摘自[url=https://evesynthetic.itch.io/love-lab-revenge]itch.io[/url]］
